commands.name: search-docs
commands.summary: Full-text search of MDN documentation, 10 results per page, optionally limited to one locale

commands.name: get-doc
commands.summary: Get one MDN doc page as structured JSON: title, summary, body sections (HTML), TOC, parents, translations, and BCD keys

commands.name: list-docs
commands.summary: List every doc in a locale as {title, url}, ordered by popularity (MDN's quick-search index)

commands.name: get-browser-compat
commands.summary: Get browser compatibility data (support per browser/version, status, spec URL) for a BCD feature key such as api.fetch or html.elements.details

dropped.name: get-current-user
dropped.reason: No session exists, so every user field is null and only geo country comes back. That is not useful site data for an agent, and the user info needs a login to mean anything.
